preconditions: Keep the current RUNNING deployment intact while building the clone.
Use the one advertised remaining deployment slot and an inactive unlocked private device.
Fetch the cloned blueprint after every mutation because cloned node/pin IDs change.

sequence.intent: Add one real C1/C2 inference publisher and its KUKSA output atomically
notes: Use a script-node only for a bounded P1 replay; use a container node for real model inference.
Connect the new KUKSA OUTPUT pin to the cloned Central Broker KUKSA INPUT pin.
Batch pin refs are zero-based among addPin operations, not overall operation indexes.

sequence.intent: Expose an HMI HTTP endpoint on the IVI Ethernet segment
notes: The documented addPin/batch/import schemas do not accept the ETHERNET pin type even though the cloned topology contains legacy ETHERNET pins. Do not pretend a GENERIC pin is an Ethernet link.

Use the CarSky UI or another platform-approved topology API to add a real ETHERNET pin and attach it to IVI Switch, not TCU Switch. If that path is unavailable, keep decisions on KUKSA and bridge them through the existing IVI Gateway/VHAL path.
Assign an unused 10.99.0.x address after checking all addresses in the cloned topology.
Android is 10.99.0.14 in the audited blueprint; do not reuse it.

sequence.method: UI artifact binding or supported node replacement
notes: The stock Central Broker references the stock vss artifact in the active topology.

The eight current C1/C2 output paths already exist in the 1,272-signal stock broker. Use dms-driver-safety-vss only for genuinely additional paths, after verifying its 0.0.6 definitions and binding it to a broker; artifact presence alone does not register paths.
The documented API can create/patch a node, but the tenant previously returned 404 for node PATCH; prefer clone + add/replace through a verified UI/API path.

sequence.intent: Validate and deploy to an inactive device
notes: Poll status/nodes until stable; do not stop the current deployment first.
Gate Android automation on a successful adb-exec probe, not merely a non-null conduit URL.
If Conduit remains unavailable, use the CarSky Screen/manual WebView path and make the HMI reachable over IVI Ethernet.
